rsv.content: svc 1/16 (13.43 mm2 estimate, no RTL) + ot_s81_su_sm 1/16 (8 tiles 10.42 mm2): scores / P stay inside

svc_chain.reduction_order: per half: each column folds lower -> upper, then the upper row toward the centre (W half cols 0 -> 3, E half cols 7 -> 4), then W + E at the centre fold; fixed, compiler-visible; S81U-1 must match the golden head-dim reduction order (open item 3)

host_job.decision: TDM on existing registered links (column-4 void is enclosed; no lane beside a slice)
host_job.critical_path: off the token critical path: jobs are issued ahead by the static schedule (boot program load + per-token start); priced as the dispatch lead only

slice_protocol.HP: HC projection partial (golden-subtree roots of the 24 HC coefficients), single beat, slice -> tier line -> column-3 V rung -> gunit (vstop tap + sink kind 7); same route and cost class as SC (router scores)
slice_protocol.rtl_owed: S81-SLICE: K_HP = 3'd7 in ot_s81sl_xr (relay to V like SC) and ot_s81sl_rstop (deliver as CS); S81U-1: vstop strap tap_k/sink_k[7] at gunit
